drafted_from: tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/tool-rows.json (tool:read-back-repaired-speech), do-work/check_speech_by_reading.py and reading.py, grade_and_repair_speech.py (write_result); no test runs the read-back (it needs whisper weights)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read back every span in /Work/demo/out with whisper using my settings in /Work/settings.json and tell me which ones say the wrong words." It runs tool:read-back-repaired-speech on your computer and lists every span under the bar.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads the folder a grade wrote and writes work/verify.json into it.
instructions: 1. Run tool:grade-and-repair-speech-audio (and, if used, tool:clone-speech-that-repair-could-not-fix) so the output folder holds grades.json, audio/ and work/state.json.
2. Use the same settings file the grade was made with (it names read_model, language and spoken_forms); install mlx-whisper. English speech only.
3. Say "Read back the repaired speech". Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command with your settings and the output folder.

4. Read the last JSON line ({result:{verify,files,failing}}) and work/verify.json: for each failing span, what was heard against what should be said. Zero errors against either the original read or the text passes a kept or remastered span; a cloned span must have zero against the text.

worked_examples.title: A grade-only folder: the kept span passes, the two with no audio fail
worked_examples.ask: Read back the repaired speech and tell me which spans fail.
worked_examples.given: Worked out from do-work/check_speech_by_reading.py, not run here (whisper weights are not available). The output folder is the one the real `grade` stage made from the test fixture: clean_0.40_5.00 was kept as it is and has audio, noisy_0.40_5.00 and clipped_0.40_5.00 were graded remaster but the `grade` stage did not remaster them, so they have no audio file. ASSUMPTION, not observed: whisper reads the kept span as its own text, "alpha bravo charlie delta echo", in both reads. The AI reads the row with this tools:list call, then runs: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/check_speech_by_reading.py --settings /Work/settings.json --out /Work/demo/out.
worked_examples.hands_back: It prints "clean_0.40_5.00 as-is vs_original 0 vs_transcript 0 PASS", then "3 files, 2 failing the bar:" followed by the lines "  noisy_0.40_5.00" and "  clipped_0.40_5.00" (each has the error "no audio file: grade is clone and no take passed" in verify.json), and the last line {"result": {"verify": "/Work/demo/out/work/verify.json", "files": 3, "failing": ["noisy_0.40_5.00", "clipped_0.40_5.00"]}}.
